findings: Candidate pages 210-215 were reviewed for LMO description fields (donor/parent organism, vector or method, trait/modified trait, gene identity/function).
Page 212 contains a trait/modified trait classification table (Box 1) but no donor/parent organism, vector, or gene identity/function fields.
The specific LMO description fields claimed were not found in the available candidate text.
limitations: This review assessed only the available candidate pages; other pages of Form E may contain relevant content.
The trait classification table on page 212 does not constitute the full LMO description claimed.

exclusions: Do not represent Form E as an approval, permit, authorization, certificate, submission, or regulatory determination.

findings: Page 213 contains Section A4.1 Risk Assessment (Basic information) with questions 15-18.
Question 15 asks about risk to health and safety of humans from the proposed activity.
Question 16 asks about possible hazard(s) and likelihood/consequence from genetic modification.
Questions 17-18 ask about risks from unintentional release to human health and environment.
limitations: This claim establishes that Form E asks for risk information, but does not determine the adequacy of any specific risk assessment.
This claim does not determine legal applicability, compliance, or whether work may begin.
